title: To Do List
description: (BTW:CE add-on) This addon ads a configurable to do list / goal overlay where you can write down stuffs!
body:
A simple configurable To-To-List. Has 2 modes: Goal & To Do List. In the first mode there is one field that when filled will be displayed as Goal: [whatever you put in]. On the second mode it will be displayed as a list with numbers near each entry like this: 
1. [whatever you put in]
2. [whatever you put in]
3. [whatever you put in]
e.t.c.
